_doc: Where Ultrastable's mail goes, as data. The cockpit shows it and the test checks every route has a destination, an owner of the follow-up and a closing probe. Recorded 2026-11-10 from docs/ops/OWNER-STEPS.md and HANDOFF.md; the probe is the live check to run, not one this file can run offline. Addresses of people are never stored here: destinations are named by role.

routes.forwards_to: the owner's verified mailbox (Cloudflare Email Routing rule 'pilot inbox')
routes.then: the outreach coordinator reconciles forwarded replies into outreach/state.json and marks each one
routes.probe: cockpit probe: send a test mail, see it in the owner's mailbox, see it logged in outreach/log.jsonl

routes.then: general inquiries: the owner reads them; anything that is a reply to outreach is forwarded to the pilot rule's path
routes.probe: same test mail to this address arrives in Outlook

routes.forwards_to: the owner's verified mailbox only (no address input exists)
routes.then: login codes, failing-check alerts, new owner cards, daily digest at 13:00 UTC (dashboard/README.md)

routes.forwards_to: nobody yet: sender identity is not registered, outreach runs dry-run
routes.then: owner card OUT-SENDER; until then no outreach mail leaves
